# Rotate & flip

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/image-rotate/

Rotate an image by a quarter or half turn and flip it horizontally or vertically. Export the corrected orientation as a new image.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Turn a sideways portrait 90 degrees clockwise before uploading it to a profile.

## Limits and checks

A 90-degree rotation swaps width and height. Flipping mirrors the image and can reverse text within it.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
